title: Create an Email Signature in UOS Gmail
learningOutcomes: Learners will be able to locate the Signature settings in their UOS Gmail account.
Learners will be able to create and save an email signature by following the provided instructions.
Learners will be able to verify that their email signature was saved successfully.
Learners will be able to identify the correct steps for creating and saving an email signature.

sections.heading: Welcome to the Lesson
sections.body: In this lesson, you will create and save an email signature in your UOS Gmail account. You will review the setup steps, complete the task, verify your result, and answer a short quiz.

sections.heading: Open Gmail Settings
sections.body: Sign in to your UOS Gmail account. Select the gear icon in the upper-right corner, then select Settings. In the General settings, scroll down to the Signature section.

sections.heading: Create and Save Your Signature
sections.body: Enter the approved UOS signature information in the Signature section. After entering the signature, select Save Changes before leaving the Settings page. The training tool does not automatically access or change your Gmail account.

sections.heading: Verify Your Signature
sections.body: Open a new email message in Gmail and check that your signature appears. Return to the training module and complete the assignment checklist. Do not enter your email password or other private information into the training tool.

sections.heading: Current Session Progress
sections.body: The training tool displays your current-session progress, including sections opened, assignment checklist items completed, and quiz questions answered. This information is temporary and is not permanently stored.

assignments.title: Create and Verify Your UOS Gmail Signature
assignments.instructions: Open your UOS Gmail account in a separate browser tab. Follow the lesson steps to open Settings, locate the Signature section, enter the approved UOS signature information, and save your changes. Open a new email message to verify that the signature appears. Return to the training module and confirm each completed step in the checklist. Do not enter your password or private account information into the training tool.

quizBank.prompt: Which control should you select to begin finding Gmail Settings?
options: The gear icon in the upper-right corner
quizBank.correctAnswer: The gear icon in the upper-right corner

feedback.correct: Correct. The gear icon opens Gmail Quick Settings.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. Begin by selecting the gear icon in the upper-right corner of Gmail.

quizBank.prompt: Where can you find the Signature section?

feedback.correct: Correct. The Signature section is located in Gmail General settings.
feedback.incorrect: Review the lesson. After opening Settings, find the Signature section in General settings.

quizBank.prompt: What should you do after entering your email signature?

feedback.correct: Correct. Select Save Changes before leaving Gmail Settings.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. You must select Save Changes so Gmail keeps the signature.

quizBank.prompt: How can you verify that your signature was saved?
options: Open a new email message and check whether the signature appears
quizBank.correctAnswer: Open a new email message and check whether the signature appears

feedback.correct: Correct. A new email message allows you to check whether the signature appears.
feedback.incorrect: Review the lesson. Open a new email message and check whether your signature appears.

quizBank.prompt: What information should you avoid entering into the training tool?
options: Your email password or other private account information
The number of checklist items completed
quizBank.correctAnswer: Your email password or other private account information

feedback.correct: Correct. The training tool should not collect passwords or private account information.
feedback.incorrect: Review the lesson. Never enter your password or other private account information into the training tool.
